method: Download every catalog source-manifest Release asset, verify its catalog SHA-256, parse all artifact references, compare exact URL and version/model/filename identities, HEAD-check every unpreserved UPD URL, and verify model-17 Release assets by server SHA-256 and size. Counts describe URL references, not distinct firmware builds.
current_feed_note: The stock monitor exhausted its probe budget. All unpreserved current-feed UPD URLs were separately covered by the complete archived-manifest gap probes.
